senses.gloss:
Saubalya : m. (pl.): Name of a Janapada.

Listed by Saṁjaya among the northern Janapadas (also called Deśas 6. 10. 68) of Bhāratavarṣa (matsyāḥ sukuṭyaḥ saubalyāḥ) 6. 10. 38; (for other citation see above Saudha ).
